mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for future corporate earnings and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth exceeding 200k in two consecutive months signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k in two consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances despite PAYEMS growth, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in residential construction permits and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based recovery in private demand, which increases corporate revenue visibility and reduces recession risk, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below its 12-month moving average indicates weakening real economic output, which increases the probability of a near-term recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below its 12-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances despite INDPRO decline, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% per annum signals a tightening monetary policy regime, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized in the most recent quarter, combined with rising unemployment (UNRATE), signals a weakening demand environment, increasing recession risk and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < 1.0% annualized and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite the joint GDPC1 and UNRATE condition, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate above 5.0% and a decline in non-farm payrolls below 100k indicates a labor market deterioration, reducing consumer confidence and spending, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS declines > 100k in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite the joint UNRATE and PAYEMS condition, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 105.0 (index 2017=100) for two consecutive months signals a weakening manufacturing base, which reduces corporate investment and earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances despite INDPRO < 105.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
